import_configuration.axis: Godot X width / Y up / Z depth
import_configuration.normalization: mesh bounds validated against exact ArtBrief envelope; runtime visual normalization preserves RoomDefinition dimensions

instructions: A robust 36-inch-high maker workbench fitted to the Room B envelope: thick joined oak slab with dog holes and darker end-grain breadboard ends, inset drawer bank and deep apron, four substantial legs with visible mortise-and-tenon joinery, a full lower stretcher frame, a black iron shoulder vise with screw and wood handle, and separate worn steel hardware. Preserve the 58 x 36 x 30 inch envelope and keep the BENCH_SURFACE interaction plane at y=36 inches. Targeted correction: reduce only non-metal wood albedo by 30 percent and retain the separate brass/iron response.
material_method: Reusable StandardMaterial3D wood, iron, steel and brass with scale-aware surface texture and separate material response; joinery and furniture construction are modeled as distinct meshes. Round 02 applies a wood-only albedo reduction after the first production capture showed cream-colored oak; metallic hardware stays at the incumbent value.
post_processing: import as a native Godot PackedScene
retain individually constructed mesh parts with separate wood and hardware materials
fit modeled presentation entirely within the RoomDefinition envelope
tool: Godot native furniture component authoring via RoomScale Art Factory
